Prepositions of place · 阶段复盘(第2轮): Prepositions of place tell where something is: in/on/under/behind/between/next to.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。
in + internal space: in the box|on + surface contact: on the desk|under + lower side, behind + back side|between + two objects (connected by and)|next to / beside = beside
The ball is under the bed.
The ball is under the bed.|The ball is of the bed.|The ball is at the bed.|The ball is in the bed.
column4: 考查in + internal; on + surface; between + two objects; behind/under/next to。正确句:The ball is under the bed.
